Geographies Served Milestones & Track Record The first Great India Talent School (also known as Mahan Bharat Pratibha Vidyalaya) was inaugurated in Kashirampara, Tripura, on March 29, 2017, starting with education from Class LKG to Class 3 for 350 students. --> --> Leadership Team Ved Prakash Dimri Executive Director Shubhrangshu Deb Administrator Janardana Dasa President, GITF, North East Chapter Demographics & Structure Organisation Strength None M&E Internal, External Assessors No --> Political & Religious Declarations On Affiliation if any No On Deployment Bias if any No --> Registration Details PAN Card AACTG7606G Registration Number IV-297/2016-17 CSR Form 1 CSR00033498 80G AACTG7606GF20198 12A AACTG7606GE20198 FCRA - About Headquarters Bangalore, Karnataka Since 2016 Demographies Served Youth Children --> Impact Reach & Quantitative Impact  The children from Kashirampara and the surrounding areas get education in English medium, textbooks, notebooks, uniforms, shoes, socks, sweaters, school bags, and mid-day meals entirely free of cost.  Medical camps are organized to provide free medical check–up, immunizations, etc., for students and teachers on a regular basis with appropriate follow up.  Local men and women have found employment with GITS in this area as teachers and kitchen helpers.  Essential grocery relief kits were distributed to the students and family members of GITS during the pandemic. Qualitative Impact  GITS adheres to the CBSE syllabus and children belonging to the Reang tribe get access to quality education and Macmillan books like children in the urban areas of the country.  Socio-economic development of the Reang community by providing quality education and nutritious food to children, providing employment opportunities to local youth and women in GITS and Akshaya Patra kitchen.  Children are provided freshly prepared nutritious and tasty mid-day meals with varied menus from the Akshaya Patra kitchen. This addresses classroom hunger and improves their concentration levels, thus enhancing their learning capacities. Vision and Mission The vision of the Great India Talent Foundation is to create a large learning community with features of comprehensive rural development through education and skill development.
